propositions: Comment identity is determined by persistent HLC-timestamp-to-Jira-comment-ID map, not body equality, to prevent collisions from duplicate-text or edited comments.
Returned Jira comment IDs are captured at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one via _update_one_dispatch_comments) and persisted with write-ahead save() for crash durability.
Outbound and inbound comment sync use separate authoritative identity stores (map for outbound, jira_comment_id for inbound) and skip when either key is mapped or jira_comment_id is present.
Comment sync is append-only: new comments mirror once bidirectionally; edits and deletes are never synced.
Outbound comment bodies render through RichTextCodec.to_wire with fit-then-encode ordering, and the _resolve_codec injection migrated from _IdentityCodec to the real codec for dedup-key consistency.
DC comment-diff converges after migration with zero duplicate re-posts and repeat reconciles produce no duplicates.
